REGULATORY STRATEGY MEMORANDUM
Moderna, Inc. | Regulatory Affairs

Date: 14 April 2026
To: VP Regulatory Affairs, CMO
From: James Bauer, Senior Director, Regulatory Strategy
Re: mRNA-1273.222 (Bivalent Booster) — Accelerated Approval Pathway Assessment
Classification: CONFIDENTIAL
1. Executive Summary
This memorandum outlines the regulatory strategy for mRNA-1273.222 (Bivalent Booster) with respect to Accelerated Approval Pathway Assessment. Based on current FDA guidance and recent precedent decisions, the recommended pathway offers the most efficient route to approval while managing key regulatory risks.
2. Background
mRNA-1273.222 (Bivalent Booster) is a first-in-class mRNA-based therapeutic targeting cardiovascular disease. The compound has demonstrated strong preclinical efficacy and the development team is planning to advance to pivotal studies.

4. Recommended Strategy
The Regulatory team recommends pursuing Fast Track Designation based on the strength of existing clinical and nonclinical data. This approach aligns with FDA's stated commitment to facilitating development of treatments for serious conditions and is supported by recent approvals in the same therapeutic area.

6. Next Steps
Submit Type B meeting request to FDA by 16 October 2026
Prepare Briefing Document with clinical and nonclinical data package
Engage external regulatory consultants for FDA interaction strategy
Brief Senior Leadership on regulatory pathway recommendation
